toegepas.blok: 'n Vloeistof neem die houer se vorm aan
toegepas.voor: hoë, smal glas en dit staan
toegepas.na: hoë, smal glas, en dit staan
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two main clauses (an imperative clause and 'dit staan').
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with different subjects (implied 'jy' giet, 'dit' staan).
toegepas.rede_keurder: Matches the AWS rule and the commas the lesson already uses; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.blok: 'n Vloeistof neem die houer se vorm aan
toegepas.voor: vlak bak en dit lê breed
toegepas.na: vlak bak, en dit lê breed
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two main clauses, consistent with the rest of the lesson.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with different subjects.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same pattern as change 1, keeps the paragraph consistent; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Draai hom nou skuins en groot
toegepas.na: Draai hom nou skuins, en groot
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two main clauses ('groot borrels kom' has its own subject and verb).
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en'; 'groot borrels kom' is a clause with its own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Correct AWS comma between two independent clauses; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.voor: opgeblaas het tussen jou twee hande
toegepas.na: opgeblaas het, tussen jou twee hande
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma after the embedded relative clause separates the clashing verb 'het' from the main clause, as the lesson already does in 'wat jy om jou sien, is'.
toegepas.fout: The embedded relative clause is not closed, so a Grade 4 reader may not see where 'wat jy pas opgeblaas het' ends.
toegepas.rede_keurder: There is no verb clash as the finder says, but the comma closing the relative clause is conventional and eases the first reading without changing meaning.

toegepas.voor: daardie gas is net soos lug 'n gas
toegepas.na: daardie gas is, net soos lug, 'n gas
toegepas.rede_vinder: Commas set off the comparison so the clause does not read as 'lug 'n gas' run together.
toegepas.fout: 'is net soos lug 'n gas' runs together and invites the misreading 'is just like air'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The commas set off the comparison and remove the stumble without adding or changing words.

laat_vaar.voor: stoot terug teen jou twee hande
laat_vaar.na: stoot teen jou twee hande terug
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The separable verb 'terugstoot' reads more naturally with its particle at the end of the clause.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'stoot terug teen jou hande' is natural Afrikaans; moving the particle is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.voor: Die water styg by die mond in
laat_vaar.na: Die water stroom by die mond in
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'styg ... in' is an unnatural verb combination; 'stroom by die mond in' is idiomatic and keeps the meaning of water entering the bottle.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'styg' carries the upward movement of the water into the upturned bottle, which 'stroom' loses, and the original reads acceptably.

laat_vaar.blok: Hoe jy die drie uitmekaar ken
laat_vaar.voor: Vra laastens of sy stil boonste kant plat lê
laat_vaar.na: Vra laastens of die materiaal se stil boonste kant plat lê
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'sy' here has no clear antecedent in the sentence and can be misread as 'she'; naming the material makes the reference clear and leaves 'stil boonste kant' intact.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'sy' is the ordinary possessive of 'dit' (the material in the previous questions) and cannot be read as 'she' here; the proposal only lengthens the sentence.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: 'n Vloeistof neem die houer se vorm aan
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'n Bietjie water is the natural, simpler Grade 4 phrasing for the same amount.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Hoeveelheid' links to 'dieselfde hoeveelheid water' three sentences later, which is the point of the block, so the swap disturbs a neighbour.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: diep onder die water in 'n emmer in
laat_vaar_vorige.na: diep onder die water in 'n emmer
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The double in is clumsy; the closing in is unnecessary.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The in...in circumposition is grammatical Afrikaans for motion into the water, and dropping a particle from an activity step is not worth the risk.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Repeating the article reads more naturally for two separate objects.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'n Glas of bak is natural Afrikaans with a shared article, and the glossary entry should not be touched for a lateral move.
